claims.text: The previous article diagnosed a homepage that led with a property nobody can look at and promised the rebuild would be put next to those screenshots so the comparison could be made honestly; this is that comparison.
claims.quote: the rebuild would be put next to those screenshots so the comparison could be made honestly

claims.text: The hero sentence changed from the encrypted git for humans and AI agents to: a vault is a unit of work, data, app, history and sources, shipped as one string.
claims.quote: a vault is a unit of work: data, app, history and sources, shipped as one string.

claims.text: Encryption did not leave; it became the subordinate clause, and the server that stores it cannot read it, which is where a property you cannot see belongs.
claims.quote: which is where a property you cannot see belongs

claims.text: The four hero cards are chosen by a hero field in the vault data, so changing the front door is a data edit, not a page edit.
claims.quote: so changing the front door is a data edit, not a page edit

claims.text: The five category cards became six real vaults chosen by the job they do: hand over a report, publish a standard as data, give a talk, pitch an investor, ship a game that reports back, give an agent a workspace.
claims.quote: Hand over a report. Publish a standard as data. Give a talk. Pitch an investor. Ship a game that reports back. Give an agent a workspace.

claims.text: None of the six lines is about encryption; they are properties of a vault as a unit, which is what a newcomer can actually feel.
claims.quote: none of those six lines is about encryption

claims.text: The collaboration story got a front door: a band with four numbers computed at build time, releases, vaults, sibling sites and briefs, and the loop told in three beats with the artefacts linked.
claims.quote: Four numbers computed at build time (releases, vaults, sibling sites, briefs)

claims.text: The numbers are not typed: releases come from the version log, vaults from the vault data, sites from the network directory, briefs from the briefs page; if one is wrong the site is wrong somewhere else too.
claims.quote: If a number on that band is wrong, the site is wrong somewhere else too, and that is the right dependency.

claims.text: Cut: the abstract use-case band, and the full band explaining sgit, SG/Vault and SG/Send, now a single pill in the trust strip; the terminal walkthrough moved down under the heading Under the hood, it is git.
claims.quote: The sgit / SG/Vault / SG/Send explanation was a full band.

claims.text: The band count did not change, nine before and nine after: three were cut and three were added, so what changed is the order and what comes first, not the length.
claims.quote: The band count did not change, nine before, nine after: three were cut and three were added

value.unit: bands on the homepage, before and after

claims.text: The first version of that paragraph said nine became eight; it was corrected in v0.2.61 after counting rather than remembering.
claims.quote: it was corrected in v0.2.61 after counting rather than remembering

claims.text: The page is longer in bytes, because it carries ten screenshots, and slightly shorter in words, 1,370 to 1,332: pictures of real things instead of paragraphs about them.

value.unit: words on the homepage, after and before

claims.text: The screenshots load lazily and through the same mechanism every vault page uses, so the page still renders from inside a vault.
claims.quote: so the page still renders from inside a vault

claims.text: The previous article named a gap and the rebuild did not close it: no published vault demonstrates two agents on one vault, their branches and a human merging them.
claims.quote: The previous article named a gap, and the rebuild did not close it

claims.text: The team band tells the story of agents building for each other, which is evidenced, not yet of agents building with each other in the same history, and is written so that it does not pretend otherwise.
claims.quote: The band is written so that it does not pretend otherwise.

claims.text: When the vault that shows two agents and a human merge exists, it goes in the hero.
claims.quote: When that vault exists, it goes in the hero.

claims.text: One file, admin/content/vaults.json, now drives the hero cards, the six jobs, the sortable table and the vault count: the homepage stopped being a page somebody edits and became a view over the site's own data.
claims.quote: The homepage stopped being a page somebody edits and became a view over the site's own data

claims.text: Adding a vault is adding a row; promoting one to the front door is setting a field, the same rule the articles band, the network directory and the update feed already followed.
claims.quote: Adding a vault is adding a row; promoting one to the front door is setting a field.

entities.role: the site whose rebuilt homepage is compared with the before pictures
whose three-door explanation became a single pill

dates.what: The homepage rebuilt and compared with the before pictures; the band count corrected in v0.2.61
